sections.title: Expedite first
sections.sql: SELECT reference,supplier,item,outstanding,needed_on,promise_on,reason FROM expedite_queue WHERE reason <> 'on plan' ORDER BY overdue DESC,needed_on

sections.title: Follow-ups due
sections.sql: SELECT d.reference,f.note,f.owner,f.due_on FROM followups f JOIN delivery_position d ON d.id=f.line_id WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND due_on<=current_date+7 ORDER BY due_on

sections.title: Delivery evidence
sections.note: On-time counts use completed lines with no opening received balance. Imported opening balances have unknown receipt timing. No percentage is inferred from them.
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,open_lines,overdue_lines,late_promises,measured_deliveries,on_time_deliveries,timing_unknown_lines FROM supplier_scorecard ORDER BY name

sections.title: Evidence and retention
sections.note: These are record checks, not a certification of legal compliance. See docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: SELECT rule,record,finding FROM compliance_findings ORDER BY rule,record
